description: JIRA integration rules. All agents that touch JIRA read this for consistent behaviour. SHARED policy: keep identical copies in sync across tester-skill, defect-skill, and retest-skill assets/.

connection.projectKey: DERIVED at runtime from the story key (storyKey.split('-')[0], e.g. BREW-94 -> BREW). NOT a field in pipeline-config.json — never look it up there.

deduplication.strategy: Search by TC-ID in summary field before creating

resilience.healthCheckBefore: Make lightweight getJiraIssue call before batched operations
resilience.onDoubleFailure: Do NOT fabricate keys or transitions. Record the pending JIRA work in the skill's own output (test-cases.json / defect-summary.json / retest-summary.json) with status 'JIRA pending' and log ❌ in the human summary, then inform the user. (There is no separate jira-updates-pending.json file — the skill's normal output IS the record of pending work.)
